name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: U.S.-Russia Talks on Ukraine Now Involve an Oil Deal Tied to Trump Allies
changes.summary: President Vladimir V. Putin brought up a sale of Russian energy assets with President Trump’s envoys, Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff, pushing a deal that raises new questions about conflicts of interest.

changes.title: Jon Gruden fires up Trump rally crowd in Ohio as if delivering a locker room speech then delivers endorsement
changes.summary: Super Bowl winning football coach Jon Gruden had an NFL reputation for using his fire and enthusiasm, not to mention his offensive strategies, to great success and we saw some of that at the rally President Donald Trump held Saturday night in Ohio. First of all, who knew Gruden was a conservative? He watched the presid.

changes.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
changes.summary: Latino voters helped propel Donald Trump back to the White House.

changes.title: Politics chat: Midterm polls, Senate races, Trump in Texas
changes.summary: As polls come out with increasing frequency closer to the midterm election, how much credence should voters give them? Meanwhile, President Trump continues campaigning for GOP candidates.

changes.title: Democrats Lead Governor Races Deep in Republican Territory, Polls Show
changes.summary: Democratic advantages in the races for governor in Texas, Iowa, Ohio and Alaska reflect deep unhappiness with President Trump and the economy. A Republican leads in Kansas.

changes.title: Trump, campaigning in Ohio, says the midterms will bring a ‘big surprise’
changes.summary: VANDALIA, Ohio — President Donald Trump rallied Saturday for Republicans in Ohio’s competitive races for Senate and governor, predicting that the party will defy expectations in a choppy midterm election climate.

changes.title: In Alabama, Trump Relives His Glory Days (This Time With Some Empty Seats)
changes.summary: The Deep South was the birthplace of the mega MAGA rally. How do people on the Gulf feel about President Trump now?

changes.title: Democrats May Have Found the Recipe for Flipping Red-State Senate Seats
changes.summary: Five new Times/Siena polls continue a run of strong results for Democrats in states that President Trump won easily in 2024.

changes.title: Trump urges daylight saving time bill supporters to personally call Sen. Cotton
changes.summary: President Trump urged supporters to call what appears to be the senator's personal cellphone number.

changes.title: Trump rallies in Ohio to boost Jon Husted in a tight Senate race against Sherrod Brown
changes.summary: Saturday's rally is just outside Dayton, Ohio, where he is stumping for key candidates in competitive races for the House, Senate and the governor's mansion in Columbus.
